bookingOpens: Online through TableCheck, either for a set menu or for a table only, choosing from the menus on the day; or by phone or email (bhr.tyobt.restaurant@bulgarihotels.com).
cancellation: Cancellations within 48 hours of the booking are charged 100%. A table may be given away if guests are more than 30 minutes late without calling.
groups: Parties of five or more and private room bookings by phone only. Terrace tables can't be booked.
children: Guests must be 12 or older, except children staying at the Bvlgari Hotel Tokyo.
duration: Tables are held for two hours.
